name: Germany

pet.recycling_rate: SOURCE: 97.6% of PET beverage bottles recycled in Germany in 2023, 96.1% of deposit bottles returned through the deposit system (GVM study for Forum PET, November 2024)
hdpe.recycling_rate: SOURCE: 52.2% of plastic packaging recycled in Germany in 2023 (BMUV, packaging waste statistics from the GVM survey, 2025; EU calculation rules); all plastics together
ldpe.recycling_rate: SOURCE: 52.2% of plastic packaging recycled in Germany in 2023 (BMUV, packaging waste statistics from the GVM survey, 2025); all plastics together, films are usually below the average
aluminium.recycling_rate: SOURCE: 99% of aluminium beverage cans recycled in Germany, where cans carry a deposit (European Aluminium and Metal Packaging Europe, beverage can recycling results 2023); 68.0% for all aluminium packaging in 2023 (BMUV, 2025)

glass.end_of_life.source: SOURCE: 80.6% of glass packaging recycled in Germany in 2023 (BMUV, packaging waste statistics from the GVM survey, 2025); the rest follows municipal waste, 30% incinerated and about 1% landfilled in 2022 (EEA country profile 2025)

liquid_packaging_board.recycling_rate: SOURCE: beverage cartons collected by the dual systems in Germany: about 69% recycled in 2023, below the 80% statutory target (ZSVR, recycling rates 2018 to 2023, read from the published chart); 112.5 kt recycled in 2022 (UBA Texte 156/2024)
pet.recycled_content: SOURCE: 48% recycled PET in deposit single use PET bottles in Germany in 2023, 46.9% across all new PET bottles (GVM study for Forum PET, November 2024)
refillable.trips: SOURCE: refillable bottles in Germany: pool glass bottles 36 to 38 trips, individual glass bottles 23, refillable PET 19 (Unternehmensberatung Weihenstephan for BVE and HDE, 2013, reported by Lebensmittel Praxis); the range covers individual bottles and well run pools
